verdict.rationale: Calendly's own pages advertise multi-host sales demo event types and 'Round-robin & team scheduling', and say it checks synced calendars for conflicts before booking. A community user also names collective events as a Calendly feature that alternatives lack. However, no first-party doc describes collective events or confirms that only slots where every required host is free are shown. missing for 10: first-party documentation of collective event types, explicit description of all-required-hosts availability intersection, required vs. optional host configuration, hands-on corroboration of slot behavior.
